title: Should Your Staff Eat for Free?

scenes.say: If leftovers are the only free food your staff get, look at what that tells them.
A real staff meal isn't a fourteen dollar plate to you. At food cost, say it's three dollars fifty.
For that, nobody works the rush hungry. Your staff taste the menu, so they can sell it. And the big one: a team that feels looked after.

props.caption: What a real meal *buys* you
items: Staff who can sell the menu
A team that feels looked after

scenes.say: So: cook one real staff meal every shift. Try new dishes on the team first. And sit down together for ten minutes.

props.title: Feed the team
steps: One real staff meal a shift
Try new dishes on the team
